audit.input_rationale: Negative control: the Decisions primary-navigation entry is temporarily moved after Monitor in web/src/components/app-shell.tsx; the decisions nav-order test is expected to fail. The recipe runs Playwright from web/ against the Vite dev server that playwright.config.ts launches through scripts/validation_resources.py, with every /v1 response mocked by page.route, so no backend, network service, or database is read. Worktree inputs (sources, specs, web/node_modules, scripts) are hashed by the helper. External inputs: the wrapper makefile and summarize.py, the Node 24.22.1 install with npm/npx and their /usr/local/bin links, the Python 3.12 standard library, the Chromium and headless-shell builds under PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH, the shared libraries Chromium links from /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu, and the font files and fontconfig it renders with. HOME holds no .npmrc or .gitconfig. Playwright output and the JSON report go to the task cache through PLAYWRIGHT_OUTPUT_DIR and TMPDIR, so nothing is written into the worktree. Symlink targets outside those roots are inventoried too: /etc/python3.12 (sitecustomize), /usr/share/fontconfig (fontconfig conf.avail targets), the two /usr/lib/llvm-18/lib files (libLLVM.so.1 and libclang-cpp.so.18.1) that links in the shared-library directory resolve to; the whole llvm-18 tree is not listed because its build/Release and build/Debug+Asserts links point back at the tree, and /usr/share/poppler (cMap links under the fonts directory).
